static_traits.name: 林伟
static_traits.social_status: 缺乏社会支持；与知晓其困扰的人Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；not yet接受过类似心理治疗；既往not yet出现与拼写或自责相关的问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述情境与感受；思维偏负面、反复自责；对改变持怀疑但愿意尝试；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt guilt and self-blame about my current spelling ability.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realized self-blame and guilt are affecting my daily life and causing significant suffering.
growth_experiences: 三年级赢得拼字比赛，此后将过去的成功视为必须永远维持的标准；当拼写not如从前时，将责任完全归咎于自己，并长期陷入内疚与自责。
婚姻史为多次离婚，伴随Interpersonal tension与Weak social support，这些经历加剧了自尊与信心的受损。

special_situations.event: Needs to send emails or fill out reports at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果拼写出现任何错误，就说明我not称职、我失败了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcibly ignores negative emotions, toughing it out to complete the task
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is my fault; I should keep practicing all along, otherwise I mess it up

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能像三年级时那样拼写完美，就说明我退步且not可原谅
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过被其他工作或任务分散注意力来暂时缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 每一个错误都在被放大，我not如过去的自己

special_situations.event: Encountering any task requiring spelling (writing emails, filling forms, writing reports, etc.)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在拼写not好，就证明我就是not行，并且以后也会一直如此
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我总是会搞砸，not yet来也会这样

special_situations.event: Recalling winning a spelling bee in third grade
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Past success set the standard I must always reach; falling below this standard equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 贬低或deny现在任何积极变化，将注意力集中在错误上
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次获胜not算数，当前的失误才说明我失败

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable, to maintain past excellent performance to safeguard self-esteem
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and criticism, leading to collapse of self-worth and disappointing others
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over mistakes through self-blame
Repression情绪并硬撑完成任务以避免暴露脆弱

object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judge who magnifies mistakes

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying behavioral experiments or changing cognitions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为without论做什么都have not用，最终仍会回到原点（改变without效）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用稳定、Empathy的语气，承认其怀疑，邀请以“小步尝试”为框架，强调not以成败评判，仅收集经验。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about specific mistakes or when self-blame and guilt are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Blames all mistakes on herself to avoid facing possible evaluation or criticism from others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 避免Reinforcement自责，用温和的反映与重述，引导区分事实与评价，并鼓励自我慈悲语句。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the gap between past success and the present
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把过去的外在标准not加消化地当作绝对规则（必须永远完美）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Inquiring in a curious and respectful tone about the source and applicable scope of that standard, inviting a re-evaluation using a continuum and concrete evidence.

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该一直保持练习”的自我要求
Takes past success as an absolute standard that must always be maintained

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 反复自责并认为“It is all my fault”
Cautious and skeptical about trying change, worries about failing again

positive_force: Won a spelling bee in third grade, showing basic language and spelling ability
能够清晰描述问题循环（识do not自责—Anxiety—进一步自责的模式）
Willing to try small behavioral experiments to test beliefs
negative_force: Cognitive biases are marked (Should Statements, Mental Filtering, Overgeneralization, Disqualifying the Positive, etc.)
以过去完美标准评判当下表现，导致Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在需要拼写时出现显著的Anxiety与自责
target_behavior.core_reason: 将三年级的成功内化为必须永远维持的完美标准，对当前错误进行灾难化与全或without评判并完全自我归责
target_behavior.function: Escapes external evaluation and shame (gaining a sense of control by enduring through self-blame and ignoring emotions)
target_behavior.consequence: 自尊与信心下降，工作与学习中的专注与效率受损，Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids emotions and forcibly ignores them, grits through tasks
antecedent: 遇到拼写任务时感到内疚与Anxiety
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心直面负面情绪会加剧痛苦，认为只能Repression情绪才能继续工作
target_behavior.function: 避免停下来面对Anxiety，维持任务表面完成
target_behavior.consequence: Intensifying negative emotions，形成反复的自责—Anxiety—硬撑的恶性循环
